_notes.about: Lesson 15 in English (en and en-GB, which has its own keyboard). From the lesson plan "Typing Game Sentence Bank: Lessons 2-13". The id is the lesson's scoreboard: never change it.
_notes.intro: Page 1, before the keys: anything that doesn't fit on Page 2 (lesson 1: "what is touch typing?"). Leave it out and the lesson starts at the new keys. "title" and "paragraphs"; in a paragraph, **bold** and [E] (a key drawn as a key: [space], [;], [Tab] ...). "picture": "hands" (the default: the hands over the lesson's keyboard), "none", or a picture file in images/ (with "pictureAlt", what it shows). With "hands": "reach" sends fingers to keys ({"lm": "e", "rm": "i"}: lp lr lm li, rp rr rm ri; keys "e", ";", "ShiftL", "ShiftR" ...; the others stay home), and "keys" says which keys show: "letters" (the default), "shift", "symbols" or "all".
_notes.hideHand: "left", "right" or "none": that hand isn't drawn on Page 2, and its column of new keys isn't listed.
_notes.sentenceLists: Up to four lists: name (shown above the typing box, or ""), count (how many to pick at random each attempt; 0 = unused) and sentences. Use real words, and only keys taught so far. Lesson 1 has no end mark because ";" hasn't been taught. Write ⇥ for the Tab key and ↵ for Enter.

title: Lesson 15: Numbers 1 to 5

intro.title: The number row: 1 to 5
paragraphs: The numbers are on the top row of the keyboard, above the letters. It's the longest reach yet: two rows up from the home row.

The left hand types [1] to [5]: the little finger [1], the ring finger [2], the middle finger [3], and the index finger both [4] and [5]. Lift your hand a little, reach up, and come back to the home row after each number.

reaches.caption: [1] [2] [3] [4]: each finger straight up from its home key
[5]: the left index finger, up and in

advice: [1] is above [Q]: reach up with your left little finger. [2] is above [W] (ring finger), and [3] above [E] (middle finger).
[4] is above [R], and [5] above [T]: both are for your left index finger.
Keep your eyes on the screen. If you must look, look quickly, then find the home row again by the bump on [F].

sentences: We need 4 cups of rice for 5 people.
The school has 3 classes on the 1st floor.
Hawa bought 24 eggs and 3 loaves of bread.
Ibrahim scored 2 goals in the 3rd game.
Our team won 4 games and lost 1.
The trip to Bo takes 4 hours.
Sheku is 13 and his sister is 11.
There are 52 cards in a pack.
We meet at 4 PM on Saturday.
Jeneba walked 5 miles to the well.
The clinic is 2 miles from here.
